notice: SYNTHETIC: Aurora Orchard and all statements below are fictional teaching fixtures, not a real annual report.
pages:
Aurora Orchard recorded revenue of USD 120 million in 2024. Its gross profit was USD 36 million.

Aurora Orchard sells apples and pears to local grocery stores. The company operates two packing facilities.

Aurora Orchard uses drip irrigation to reduce water consumption. Water use fell by 8 percent in this fictional example.

Aurora Orchard trains seasonal workers before the harvest. Safety training covers ladders and packing equipment.
